name.zh: 后梁援潞州：汴州→洛阳→潞州
name.en: Later Liang to Luzhou: Bianzhou → Luoyang → Luzhou

description.zh: 后梁与晋争夺潞州，梁军自汴州经洛阳北上潞州，相持数年。
description.en: Later Liang and Jin contested Luzhou for years; Liang forces marched north via Luoyang.

extensions.note: 依史实地名与进军方向连点示意，非实测路线。

name.zh: 晋军潞州防御：太原→潞州
name.en: Jin defense of Luzhou: Taiyuan → Luzhou

description.zh: 李存勖自太原南下救援潞州，与梁军相持。
description.en: Li Cunxu marched south from Taiyuan to relieve Luzhou.

extensions.note: 依史实地名与进军方向连点示意，非实测路线。

name.zh: 后唐奇袭汴州：太原→郓州→汴州
name.en: Later Tang dash to Bianzhou: Taiyuan → Yunzhou → Bianzhou

description.zh: 李存勖自太原南下，经郓州奇袭汴州，后梁亡。
description.en: Li Cunxu marched south via Yunzhou and took Bianzhou by surprise, ending Later Liang.

extensions.note: 依史实地名与进军方向连点示意，非实测路线。

name.zh: 后梁汴州防御：中牟—汴州—陈留
name.en: Later Liang defense of Bianzhou: Zhongmu–Bianzhou–Chenliu

description.zh: 后梁末帝困守汴州，沿汴州东西布防。
description.en: Emperor Mo of Later Liang held Bianzhou, deploying forces east and west of the capital.

extensions.note: 依史实地名与进军方向连点示意，非实测路线。

name.zh: 后唐南下胡柳陂：太原→潞州→胡柳陂
name.en: Later Tang to Hulangpi: Taiyuan → Luzhou → Hulangpi

description.zh: 李存勖自太原南下，与后梁军战于胡柳陂。
description.en: Li Cunxu marched south and fought the Later Liang army at Hulangpi.

extensions.note: 依史实地名与进军方向连点示意，非实测路线。

name.zh: 后梁胡柳陂防线：汴州—胡柳陂—许州
name.en: Later Liang line at Hulangpi: Bianzhou–Hulangpi–Xuzhou

description.zh: 后梁军在汴州以南迎击晋军。
description.en: Later Liang forces met the Jin army south of Bianzhou.

extensions.note: 依史实地名与进军方向连点示意，非实测路线。

name.zh: 前蜀剑门防御：剑门—绵州—成都
name.en: Former Shu defense: Jianmen–Mianzhou–Chengdu

description.zh: 前蜀以剑门为屏障，退守绵州、成都，王衍出降。
description.en: Former Shu held Jianmen, fell back to Mianzhou and Chengdu, and Wang Yan surrendered.

extensions.note: 依史实地名与进军方向连点示意，非实测路线。

name.zh: 闽军建州—福州防御
name.en: Min defense: Jianzhou–Fuzhou

description.zh: 闽国内乱，建州、福州相继失守。
description.en: Min, torn by internal strife, lost Jianzhou and then Fuzhou.

extensions.note: 依史实地名与进军方向连点示意，非实测路线。

name.zh: 后晋澶州—汴州防线
name.en: Later Jin line: Chanzhou–Bianzhou

description.zh: 辽军南下，后晋沿澶州、滑州节节抵抗，汴州失守。
description.en: Later Jin resisted along Chanzhou and Huazhou as the Liao army advanced; Bianzhou fell.

extensions.note: 依史实地名与进军方向连点示意，非实测路线。

name.zh: 后周亲征高平：汴州→泽州→高平
name.en: Later Zhou to Gaoping: Bianzhou → Zezhou → Gaoping

description.zh: 柴荣自汴州北上，经泽州至高平迎战北汉、辽联军。
description.en: Chai Rong marched north via Zezhou to Gaoping against the Northern Han–Liao army.

extensions.note: 依史实地名与进军方向连点示意，非实测路线。

name.zh: 北汉南下高平：太原→潞州→高平
name.en: Northern Han to Gaoping: Taiyuan → Luzhou → Gaoping

description.zh: 刘崇自太原南下，联合辽军进攻后周。
description.en: Liu Chong marched south from Taiyuan with Liao support against Later Zhou.

extensions.note: 依史实地名与进军方向连点示意，非实测路线。

name.zh: 辽军援北汉：幽州→定州→高平
name.en: Liao relief to Gaoping: Youzhou → Dingzhou → Gaoping

description.zh: 辽军自幽州南下，与北汉会师高平。
description.en: Liao forces marched south from Youzhou and joined Northern Han at Gaoping.

extensions.note: 依史实地名与进军方向连点示意，非实测路线。

name.zh: 后蜀秦凤防线：秦州→凤州→兴元→剑门→成都
name.en: Later Shu Qin–Feng line: Qinzhou → Fengzhou → Xingyuan → Jianmen → Chengdu

description.zh: 后周攻秦凤，后蜀自秦州、凤州退守兴元、剑门、成都。
description.en: Under Later Zhou attack, Later Shu fell back from Qinzhou and Fengzhou to Xingyuan, Jianmen and Chengdu.

extensions.note: 依史实地名与进军方向连点示意，非实测路线。

name.zh: 南唐淮南防线：寿州—庐州—滁州
name.en: Southern Tang Huainan line: Shouzhou–Luzhou–Chuzhou

description.zh: 后周三征淮南，南唐沿寿州、庐州、滁州设防，终失淮南十四州。
description.en: Southern Tang defended Shouzhou, Luzhou and Chuzhou through three Later Zhou campaigns, ultimately losing fourteen prefectures.

extensions.note: 依史实地名与进军方向连点示意，非实测路线。

name.zh: 南唐清流关防线：清流关—滁州
name.en: Southern Tang line at Qingliu Pass: Qingliuguan–Chuzhou

description.zh: 南唐守清流关，赵匡胤夜袭破关。
description.en: Southern Tang held Qingliu Pass until Zhao Kuangyin stormed it by night.

extensions.note: 依史实地名与进军方向连点示意，非实测路线。

name.zh: 辽南京防线：幽州—涿州—三关
name.en: Liao southern line: Youzhou–Zhuozhou–Three Passes

description.zh: 柴荣北伐，辽军自幽州、涿州退守瓦桥、益津、淤口三关。
description.en: Under Chai Rong’s northern campaign, Liao forces fell back from Youzhou and Zhuozhou to the three passes.

extensions.note: 依史实地名与进军方向连点示意，非实测路线。

name.zh: 荆南江陵防御：荆门—江陵
name.en: Jingnan defense: Jingmen–Jiangling

description.zh: 宋军借道南下，高继冲在江陵纳土。
description.en: Song forces passed through; Gao Jichong submitted at Jiangling.

extensions.note: 依史实地名与进军方向连点示意，非实测路线。

name.zh: 武平朗州—长沙防线
name.en: Wuping line: Langzhou–Changsha

description.zh: 武平内乱，宋军自江陵南下，周保权被执。
description.en: Wuping, weakened by internal strife, was overrun by Song forces advancing from Jiangling.

extensions.note: 依史实地名与进军方向连点示意，非实测路线。

name.zh: 后蜀剑门—成都防御
name.en: Later Shu defense: Jianmen–Chengdu

description.zh: 宋军两路入蜀，后蜀守剑门、成都，孟昶出降。
description.en: Song armies invaded on two routes; Later Shu held Jianmen and Chengdu until Meng Chang surrendered.

extensions.note: 依史实地名与进军方向连点示意，非实测路线。

name.zh: 南汉韶州—广州防御
name.en: Southern Han defense: Shaozhou–Guangzhou

description.zh: 宋军南下，南汉失韶州，退守广州，刘鋹出降。
description.en: Song forces took Shaozhou; Southern Han fell back on Guangzhou and Liu Chang surrendered.

extensions.note: 依史实地名与进军方向连点示意，非实测路线。

name.zh: 南唐长江防线：采石—当涂—金陵
name.en: Southern Tang Yangtze line: Caishi–Dangtu–Jinling

description.zh: 宋军架浮桥渡江，南唐沿采石、当涂、金陵设防，金陵城破。
description.en: Song forces bridged the Yangtze; Southern Tang defended Caishi, Dangtu and Jinling until the capital fell.

extensions.note: 依史实地名与进军方向连点示意，非实测路线。

name.zh: 北汉代州—太原防御
name.en: Northern Han defense: Daizhou–Taiyuan

description.zh: 宋军围太原，北汉以代州、忻州为外围，城破出降。
description.en: Song forces besieged Taiyuan; Northern Han held Daizhou and Xinzhou as outer defenses before surrendering.

extensions.note: 依史实地名与进军方向连点示意，非实测路线。

name.zh: 辽军援北汉：幽州→蔚州→太原
name.en: Liao relief to Taiyuan: Youzhou → Yuzhou → Taiyuan

description.zh: 辽军自幽州西援北汉，被宋军阻于石岭关外。
description.en: Liao forces marched west to relieve Northern Han but were checked outside Shiling Pass.

extensions.note: 依史实地名与进军方向连点示意，非实测路线。

name.zh: 宋军北伐幽州：太原→镇州→幽州
name.en: Song northern march: Taiyuan → Zhenzhou → Youzhou

description.zh: 灭北汉后，赵光义乘胜自太原东出，经镇州北上幽州。
description.en: After destroying Northern Han, Zhao Guangyi marched east from Taiyuan via Zhenzhou toward Youzhou.

extensions.note: 依史实地名与进军方向连点示意，非实测路线。

name.zh: 辽军高梁河反击：幽州—高梁河—涿州
name.en: Liao counterattack at Gaoliang River: Youzhou–Gaolianghe–Zhuozhou

description.zh: 辽军自幽州出击，在高梁河大败宋军。
description.en: Liao forces sortied from Youzhou and routed the Song army at the Gaoliang River.

extensions.note: 依史实地名与进军方向连点示意，非实测路线。

name.zh: 武平复湖南：朗州→益阳→长沙
name.en: Wuping retakes Hunan: Langzhou → Yiyang → Changsha

description.zh: 刘言遣王逵、周行逢自朗州南下，逐南唐边镐，复取长沙。
description.en: Liu Yan sent Wang Kui and Zhou Xingfeng south from Langzhou, expelling the Southern Tang governor and retaking Changsha.

extensions.note: 依史实地名与进军方向连点示意，非实测路线。

name.zh: 南唐长沙防御：长沙—益阳
name.en: Southern Tang defense of Changsha: Changsha–Yiyang

description.zh: 南唐边镐镇长沙，武平军自朗州来攻，边镐弃城走。
description.en: Southern Tang’s Bian Gao held Changsha; attacked from Langzhou, he abandoned the city.

extensions.note: 依史实地名与进军方向连点示意，非实测路线。

name.zh: 南唐攻福州：建州→福州
name.en: Southern Tang attacks Fuzhou: Jianzhou → Fuzhou

description.zh: 南唐自建州出兵攻福州，李仁达求救于吴越。
description.en: Southern Tang marched from Jianzhou against Fuzhou; Li Renda appealed to Wuyue.

extensions.note: 依史实地名与进军方向连点示意，非实测路线。

name.zh: 福州防御：古田—福州
name.en: Fuzhou defense: Gutian–Fuzhou

description.zh: 李仁达据福州，依托古田、福州城拒南唐。
description.en: Li Renda held Fuzhou, defending the Gutian approach and the city against Southern Tang.

extensions.note: 依史实地名与进军方向连点示意，非实测路线。

name.zh: 吴越泛海援福州：杭州→宁波→温州→福州
name.en: Wuyue sea relief to Fuzhou: Hangzhou → Ningbo → Wenzhou → Fuzhou

description.zh: 吴越遣张筠等自杭州泛海南下，援福州，败南唐军。
description.en: Wuyue sent Zhang Yun by sea from Hangzhou to relieve Fuzhou and defeated the Southern Tang army.

extensions.note: 依史实地名与进军方向连点示意，非实测路线。

name.zh: 辽军南侵澶州：幽州→定州→邢州→澶州
name.en: Liao invasion to Chanzhou: Youzhou → Dingzhou → Xingzhou → Chanzhou

description.zh: 辽太宗第一次大举南侵，经定州、邢州至澶州，后晋拒之。
description.en: In the first great Liao invasion, Emperor Taizong marched via Dingzhou and Xingzhou to Chanzhou, where Later Jin held.

extensions.note: 依史实地名与进军方向连点示意，非实测路线。

name.zh: 后晋澶州防御：澶州—滑州—汴州
name.en: Later Jin defense: Chanzhou–Huazhou–Bianzhou

description.zh: 后晋在澶州、滑州一线阻击辽军，保住汴州。
description.en: Later Jin blocked the Liao army along Chanzhou and Huazhou, holding Bianzhou.

extensions.note: 依史实地名与进军方向连点示意，非实测路线。

name.zh: 后周攻秦凤：汴州→长安→大散关→秦州
name.en: Later Zhou to Qinzhou: Bianzhou → Chang’an → Dasanguan → Qinzhou

description.zh: 后周王景、向训自汴州经长安、大散关西进，攻后蜀秦州。
description.en: Wang Jing and Xiang Xun marched west via Chang’an and Dasanguan against Later Shu’s Qinzhou.

extensions.note: 依史实地名与进军方向连点示意，非实测路线。

name.zh: 后周取凤州：秦州→凤州
name.en: Later Zhou takes Fengzhou: Qinzhou → Fengzhou

description.zh: 后周自秦州南下，攻取凤州，后蜀失秦岭要地。
description.en: Later Zhou moved south from Qinzhou and took Fengzhou, stripping Later Shu of its Qinling strongholds.

extensions.note: 依史实地名与进军方向连点示意，非实测路线。

name.zh: 赵匡胤奇袭清流关：寿州→清流关
name.en: Zhao Kuangyin storms Qingliu Pass: Shouzhou → Qingliuguan

description.zh: 后周殿前都虞候赵匡胤自寿州东进，夜袭清流关，斩南唐大将皇甫晖。
description.en: Zhao Kuangyin marched east from Shouzhou and stormed Qingliu Pass by night, killing Southern Tang general Huangfu Hui.

extensions.note: 依史实地名与进军方向连点示意，非实测路线。
